scope: Unchanged square 6x6 J2=0.5 frozen step-1064 parent; fixed Sz=0 plus exact lattice A1, NOT exact spin SU2. Reuse two sealed SR rays per old training batch; do not estimate new directions. Calibrate each ray at TWO predeclared distances using only fresh calibration log amplitudes; freeze all eight candidates BEFORE generating a distinct audit pool. No audit retuning, no chosen winner, no long training, no remote job. Separate calibration H is diagnostic/accounted but never enters the radius fit. This is a conditional common-parent correlated-sampling experiment, not a converged variational energy or equilibration certification.
budget: 512 calibration parent full-H centers +1024 audit parent centers +8x1024 audit candidate centers =9728. No new training H, no H on biased probes. Reuse all 1724 old deterministic probe configurations, never interpret these as Born samples. Positive ray scales bounded by 4, <=30 amplitude-only distance trials each. Local CPU expected 5-10 minutes plus verification. Checkpoint every pool snapshot and matched candidate; sources/data sealed before sampling.
inference: Primary family: eight candidate-minus-parent energy/variance intervals plus four damped-minus-original energy/variance intervals =24. Audit-distance contrast intervals are descriptive. Matching is EXACT only empirically on calibration pool (tolerance 1e-6); audit distances and their mismatch are reported without correction. A 10% relative distance mismatch warns that independent equal-distance interpretation failed. Prior directions and probes have been inspected; only the NEW validation pool is untouched when candidates freeze. No true global physical-distance assertion.
